title_as_printed: Isopiestic Compositions for the Ternary System H2O-NaCl-MgCl2
property_description: 17 sets of mutually isopiestic solutions at 25 C (seven solutions per run). The first row of each set (yB = 0) is the pure NaCl solution, the last (yB = 1.0) usually pure MgCl2. 'I' is the ionic strength of each solution (molality scale implied: I = mNaCl + 3 mMgCl2), yB = 3 mMgCl2 / I (ionic-strength fraction of MgCl2, yA = mA/I = 1 - yB per the paper's Symbols list). R = M_A/(mA + 1.5 mB), the isopiestic ratio defined with M_A the molality of the pure NaCl solution in the same set (derived by the authors).
pressure_note: not stated (isopiestic equilibrium at vapour pressure of the solutions; no pressure printed)
reference_salt: NaCl (first row of each set, yB = 0)

value.what: ionic strength of the solution in isopiestic equilibrium with the other solutions of its set

composition.other_species: NaCl(A)-MgCl2(B) only; ionic strength unit not printed (molality implied)

conversion_needs: mNaCl = I(1 - yB); mMgCl2 = I yB / 3
isopiestic molality of reference NaCl is the I of the yB = 0 row in the same set
notes: Printed as three column groups side by side (sets 1-6, 7-12, 13-17); stacked here in set order. Misprint-like cells kept as printed and confirmed on the image: set 7 R 0.1062 in row yB 0.4612 (neighbours 1.0057 and 1.0223), set 17 I 0.7676 in row yB 0.8260 (neighbours 7.7090 and 7.8892, probably 7.7676). Added ionic_strength_rule: I is molal, yB = 3 mMgCl2 / I (Symbols list, p.4057), so mMgCl2 = I yB / 3 and mNaCl = I (1 - yB).

row_held.reason: printed ionic strength 0.7676 (set 17, yB 0.8260) is inconsistent with its neighbours 7.7090 and 7.8892 and with the printed R = 1.3476 (needs I about 7.7676); composition would be wrong

quality_remarks: Printed misprints, cells kept: set 7 row yB 0.4612 prints R 0.1062 (recomputes to about 1.016; neighbours 1.0057 and 1.0223); set 8 row I 1.8380, yB 0.8179 prints R 1.0150 (isopiestic definition gives about 1.051; neighbours 1.0391, 1.0655); set 17 row yB 0.8260 prints I 0.7676, probably 7.7676 (this row is held). R is derived by the authors and is not the datum. 118 of 121 rows reproduce the printed R from I and yB within 0.003.
